title: Community recipes and clearer DGX Spark launches
summary: CloudlessOS 0.2.7-2 adds signed community recipe publishing and installation, expands constrained recipe runtimes for DGX Spark, and makes long model launches visibly understandable and recoverable.
changes: Add Cloudless accounts, scoped publisher API keys, and guided community recipe publishing from both Model Manager and the Cloudless CLI.
Discover, verify, install, update, roll back, and revoke immutable community recipe revisions through the signed community catalog.
Allow constrained recipes to select their own immutable runtime images for platform-specific optimizations such as SM121 kernels, FlashInfer, and DFlash without granting arbitrary host access.
Ship and document a DGX Spark Laguna S 2.1 NVFP4 and DFlash recipe backed by a digest-pinned patched vLLM runtime.
Run topology-aware community recipes on the exact requested number of enrolled DGX Sparks, with verified image transfer and model-cache adoption for multi-node launches.
Keep recipe preparation and recovery durable across daemon restarts, clean up orphaned managed containers safely, and preserve downloaded model weights when recovery is possible.
Stop distributed recipes across every owned Spark and verify that peer containers are absent before another launch, while keeping one-node recipes isolated to one Spark.
Show dependency downloads, checkpoint shard counts, DFlash loading, kernel compilation, warmup progress, percentages, and estimated time during managed recipe startup.
Hide stale unloaded-model controls while a recipe is actively loading and prevent generic health polling from replacing detailed container progress.
Harden kiosk startup, package lifecycle behavior, community trust-root validation, and physical qualification coverage for signed community recipes.
